vb11:1.2: sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
vb11:2.2: Dukkhe ñāṇaṃ dukkhasamudaye ñāṇaṃ dukkhanirodhe ñāṇaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya ñāṇaṃ:
vb11:4.2: Musāvādā veramaṇī, pisuṇāya vācāya veramaṇī, pharusāya vācāya veramaṇī, samphappalāpā veramaṇā:
vb11:5.2: Pāṇātipātā veramaṇī, adinnādānā veramaṇī, kāmesu micchācārā veramaṇī:
vb11:6.2: Idha ariyasāvako micchā-ājīvaṃ pahāya sammā-ājīvena jīvitaṃ kappeti:
vb11:7.2: Idha bhikkhu anuppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ anupādāya chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padahati,
vb11:7.3: uppannānaṃ pāpakānaṃ akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya . . . pe . . .
vb11:7.5: uppannānaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ ṭhitiyā asammosāya bhiyyobhāvāya vepullāya bhāvanāya pāripūriyā chandaṃ janeti vāyamati viriyaṃ ārabhati cittaṃ paggaṇhāti padhati:
vb11:8.2: Idha bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ,
vb11:8.5: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ:
vb11:9.2: Idha bhikkhu vivicc' eva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati;
vb11:9.3: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati;
vb11:9.4: pītiyā ca virāgā upekhako ca viharati sato ca sampajāno sukhañ ca kāyena paṭisaṃvedeti, yan taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti: upekhako satimā sukhavihārī ti tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati;
vb11:9.5: sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbe va somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekhā-sati-pārisukkhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati:
vb11:10.2: sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammā ājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
vb11:11.2: Idha bhikhu sammādiṭṭhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ . . . pe . . .
vb11:11.9: sammāsamādhiṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
vb11:14.2: Idha bhikkhu yasmiṃ samaye lokuttaraṃ jhānaṃ bhāveti niyyānikaṃ apacayagāmiṃ diṭṭhigatānaṃ pahānāya paṭhamāya bhūmiyā pattiyā, vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo hoti:
vb11:15.2: Yā paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb11:16.2: Yo takko vitakko saṅkappo appanā vyappanā cetaso abhiniropanā sammāsaṅkappo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb11:17.2: Yā catūhi vacīduccaritehi ārati virati paṭivirati veramaṇī akiriyā akaraṇaṃ anajjhāpatti velā-anatikkamo setughāto sammāvācā maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb11:18.2: Yā tīhi kāyaduccaritehi ārati virati paṭivirati veramaṇī akiriyā akaraṇaṃ anajjhāpatti velā-anatikkamo setughāto sammākammanto maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb11:19.2: Yā micchā-ājīvā ārati virati paṭivirati veramanī akiriyā akaraṇaṃ anajjhāpatti velā-anatikkamo setughāto sammā-ājīvo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb11:20.2: Yo cetasiko viriyārambho . . . pe . . . sammāvāyāmo viriyasambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb11:21.2: Yā sati anussati . . . pe . . . sammāsati satisambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb11:22.2: Yā cittassa ṭhiti . . . pe . . . sammāsamādhi samādhisambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb11:23.1: Ayaṃ vuccati aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo. Avasesā dhammā aṭṭhaṅgikena maggena sampayuttā. Pañcaṅgiko maggo:
vb11:24.2: Idha bhikkhu yasmiṃ samaye lokuttaraṃ jhānaṃ bhāveti niyyānikaṃ apacagayāmiṃ diṭṭhigatānaṃ pahānāya paṭhamāya bhūmiyā pattiyā, vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye pañcaṅgiko maggo hoti:
vb11:25.2: Yā paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb11:26.2: Yo takko vitakko saṅkappo . . . pe . . . maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb11:27.2: Yo cetasiko viriyārambho . . . pe . . . sammavāyāmo viriyasambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb11:28.2: Yā sati anussati . . . pe . . . sammāsati satisambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb11:29.2: Yā cittassa ṭhiti . . . pe . . . sammāsamādhi samādhisambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb11:31.2: Idhi bhikkhu yasmiṃ samaye lokuttaraṃ jhānaṃ bhāveti niyyānikaṃ apacayagāmiṃ diṭṭhigatānaṃ pahānāya paṭhamāya bhūmiyā pattiyā, vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ, yā tasmiṃ samaye paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb11:32.2: Idha bhikkhu yasmiṃ samaye lokuttaraṃ jhānaṃ bhāveti niyyānikaṃ apacayagāmiṃ diṭṭhigatānaṃ pahānāya paṭhamāya bhūmiyā pattiyā vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ, yā tasmiṃ samaye cittassa ṭhiti . . . pe . . . sammāsamādhi, samādhisambojjhaṅgo, maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb11:34.2: Idha bhikkhu yasmiṃ samaye lokuttaraṃ jhānaṃ bhāveti niyyānikaṃ apacayagāmiṃ diṭṭhigatānaṃ pahānāya paṭhamāya bhūmiyā pattiyā, vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye phasso hoti . . . pe . . . avikkhepo hoti:
vb11:34.4: Tass' eva lokuttarassa kusalassa jhānassa katattā bhāvitattā vipākaṃ vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ suññataṃ; tasmiṃ samaye aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo hoti:
vb11:34.5: sammādiṭṭhi . . . pe . . . sammāsamādhi. Tattha katamā sammādiṭṭhi? Yā paññā pajānanā . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ: ayaṃ vuccati sammādiṭṭhi. Tattha katamo sammāsaṅkappo . . . sammāvācā . . . sammākammanto . . . sammā-ājīvo . . . sammāvāyāmo . . . sammāsati . . . Tattha katamo sammāsamādhi? Yā cittassa ṭhiti . . . sammāsamādhi samādhisambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ: ayaṃ vuccati sammāsamādhi.
vb11:36.2: Idha bhikkhu yasmiṃ samaye lokuttaraṃ jhānaṃ bhāveti niyyānikaṃ apacayagāmiṃ diṭṭhigatānaṃ paṭhamāya bhūmiyā pattiyā, vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye phasso hoti . . . pe . . . avikkhepo hoti:
vb11:36.4: Tass' eva lokuttarassa kusalassa jhānassa katattā bhāvitattā vipākaṃ vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ suññataṃ; tasmiṃ samaye pañcaṅgiko maggo hoti:
vb11:38.2: Idha bhikkhu yasmiṃ samaye lokuttaraṃ jhānaṃ bhāveti niyyānikaṃ apacayagāmiṃ diṭṭhigatānaṃ pahānāya paṭhamāya bhūmiyā pattiyā, vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye phasso hoti . . . pe . . . avikkhepo hoti:
vb11:38.4: Tass' eva lokuttarassa kusalassa jhānassa katattā bhāvitattā vipākaṃ vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ suññataṃ; yā tasmiṃ samaye paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb11:39.2: Idha bhikkhu yasmiṃ samaye lokuttaraṃ jhānaṃ bhāveti niyyānikaṃ apacayagāmiṃ diṭṭhigatānaṃ pahānāya paṭhamāya bhūmiyā pattiyā, vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ, tasmiṃ samaye phasso hoti . . . pe . . . avikkhepo hoti:
vb11:39.4: Tass' eva lokuttarassa kusalassa jhānassa katattā bhāvitattā vipākaṃ vivicc' eva kāmehi . . . pe . . . paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati dukkhāpaṭipadaṃ dandhābhiññaṃ suññataṃ; yā tasmiṃ samaye cittassa ṭhiti saṇṭhiti avaṭṭhiti avisāhāro avikkhepo avisāhaṭamānasatā samatho samādhindriyaṃ samādhibalaṃ sammāsamādhi samādhisambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb11:41.2: sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākammanto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
vb11:42.1: Aṭṭhannaṃ maggaṅgānaṃ kati kusalā kati akusalā kati avyākatā . . . pe . . . kati saranā kati araṇā?
vb11:44.2: satta maggaṅgā siyā sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā siyā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttā.
vb11:48.2: satta maggaṅgā siyā savitakka-savicārā siyā avitakka-vicāramattā siyā avitakka-avicārā.
vb11:49.2: satta maggaṅgā siyā pītisahagatā siyā sukhasahagatā siyā upekhāsahagatā.
vb11:52.1: Siyā apacayagāmino siyā neva ācayagāmino na apacayagāmino.
vb11:58.1: Na maggārammaṇā; siyā maggahetukā siyā maggādhipatino
vb11:58.2: siyā na vattabbā maggahetukā ti pi maggādhipatino ti pi.
vb11:59.1: Siyā uppannā siyā anuppannā siyā uppādino.
vb11:60.1: Siyā atītā siyā anāgatā siyā paccuppannā.
vb11:61.1: Na vattabbā atītārammaṇā ti pi anāgatārammaṇā ti pi paccuppannārammaṇā ti pi.
vb11:62.1: Siyā ajjhattā siyā bahiddhā siyā ajjhattabahiddhā.
vb11:65.1: Sammādiṭṭhi hetu; satta maggaṅgā na hetū; sahetukā; hetusampayuttā.
vb11:65.2: Sammādiṭṭhi hetu ceva sahetukā ca; satta maggaṅgā na vattabbā hetū ceva sahetukā cāti, sahetukā ceva na ca hetū.
vb11:65.3: Sammādiṭṭhi hetu ceva hetusampayuttā ca; satta maggaṅgā na vattabbā hetū ceva hetusampayuttā cāti, hetusampayuttā ceva na ca hetū.
vb11:65.4: Satta maggaṅgā na hetū sahetukā; sammādiṭṭhi na vattabbā na hetu sahetukā ti pi, na hetu ahetukā ti pi.
vb11:67.4: na vattabbā āsavā ceva sāsavā cāti pi, sāsavā ceva no ca āsavā ti pi;
vb11:67.5: na vattabbā āsavā ceva āsavasampayuttā cāti pi, āsavasampayuttā ceva no ca āsavā ti pi;
vb11:70.7: Sammāsaṅkappo avitakko; satta maggaṅgā siyā savitakkā siyā avitakkā.
vb11:70.8: Sammāsaṅkappo savicāro; satta maggaṅgā siyā savicārā siyā avicārā.
vb11:70.9: Sammāsaṅkappo sappītiko; satta maggaṅgā siyā sappītikā siyā appītikā.
vb11:70.10: Sammāsaṅkappo pītisahagato; satta maggaṅgā siyā pītisahagatā siyā na pītisahagatā.
vb11:70.11: Sammāsaṅkappo sukhasahagato; satta maggaṅgā siyā sukhasahagatā siyā na sukhasahagatā.
vb11:70.12: Sammāsaṅkappo na upekhāsahagato; satta maggaṅgā siyā upekhāsahagatā siyā na upekhāsahagatā.
